plan.question: What percentage of registered pregnancies completed at least four antenatal checkups, by district and year?

view.title: ANC4 Coverage by District and Year
view.note: Each line shows how the share of registered pregnancies that completed four antenatal checkups changed over time for one district. Select a year in the bar chart below to compare districts side by side for that year.

interpretation_guard.caveat: This data is a synthetic fixture for demonstration. District names are illustrative and values are not official statistics. Differences between districts may reflect real-world factors such as facility access, staffing, or community awareness, but this dataset alone cannot confirm any specific cause.
